title: Update project overview and validate roadmap
description: Expand README with the product vision and roadmap links, run Beads validation, and check repository status.
acceptance_criteria: README points to roadmap artifacts, bd lint passes, and the Phase 0 handoff reports git status.
close_reason: Roadmap artifacts committed; bd lint clean; phase 0 handoff reported.

title: Document phased delivery plan
description: Create phase specifications with work-package mappings, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and verification checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Every planned phase has a Markdown artifact and maps to Beads issues without duplicate status tracking.
close_reason: Roadmap artifacts committed; bd lint clean; phase 0 handoff reported.

title: Specify mathematical semantics
description: Document arithmetic, precision, angle, error, arbitrary-base, mixed-base, programmer, and safety-limit contracts.
acceptance_criteria: The contract is unambiguous enough to derive implementation tests without inventing missing rules.
close_reason: Roadmap artifacts committed; bd lint clean; phase 0 handoff reported.

title: Write product scope and roadmap index
description: Create the product scope and roadmap index artifacts, including audience, goals, mode map, boundaries, and Beads source-of-truth guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Scope and index documents are linked, concise, and contain the correct epic and phase IDs.
close_reason: Roadmap artifacts committed; bd lint clean; phase 0 handoff reported.

title: Phase 0: Define roadmap and mathematical contracts
description: Create the roadmap artifact index, product scope, mathematical semantics, and phased delivery specification. Link every work package to Beads and keep task status out of Markdown.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap documents are internally consistent, include Beads IDs, bd lint passes, and README communicates the project vision and current phase.
close_reason: Roadmap artifacts committed; bd lint clean; phase 0 handoff reported.

title: Build static developer calculator
description: Deliver a fully static, accessible calculator that grows from reliable basic arithmetic into scientific, trigonometric, arbitrary-base, mixed-base, programmer, and coding utility modes. Markdown roadmap artifacts define contracts; Beads remains the source of truth for task status.
acceptance_criteria: All planned phases are represented as dependent Beads features, each phase has a linked Markdown specification, and completed product phases pass their documented quality gates.

title: Property-test programmer mode
description: Add bitwise, width, mixed-base, invalid-fraction, and end-to-end tests and align semantics documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Programmer mode verification matrix and browser flows pass.

title: Support mixed-base expressions and UI
description: Parse prefixed and base#digits literals directly, show synchronized base panels, and allow result-base selection.
acceptance_criteria: Users can calculate mixed-base expressions without a separate conversion workflow.

title: Implement programmer numeric engine
description: Add exact BigInt arithmetic, bitwise operators, widths, signedness, two's complement, shifts, rotates, masks, and flags.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary, overflow, negative, signedness, and shift truth tables pass.

title: Property-test base conversion
description: Add randomized round-trip properties and end-to-end scenarios and align conversion documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Round trips across supported bases and very large values pass documented limits.

title: Build arbitrary-base converter UI
description: Add source and target base controls, presets, swap, copy, grouping, validation, and accessible errors.
acceptance_criteria: Common and arbitrary base conversion workflows work by keyboard, touch, and pointer.

title: Implement exact arbitrary-base core
description: Parse signed base-2-through-36 integers and fractions to exact rational values and format target bases with repeat limits.
acceptance_criteria: Large, negative, fractional, invalid-digit, and truncation unit tests pass without floating-point conversion.

title: Verify scientific and trig matrices
description: Add golden-value, property, domain, and E2E tests and align feature documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Documented scientific and trigonometric verification matrix passes.
close_reason: 35 vitest cases (6 files) cover scientific matrix (angle identities, round-trips, domain errors, factorial limits, precision formatting) and view interactions. Lint, typecheck, build green.

title: Implement trigonometry and scientific UI
description: Add DEG/RAD/GRAD trig and inverse/hyperbolic functions with accessible expandable controls and memory registers.
acceptance_criteria: Angle selector is always visible and all angle-mode browser flows pass.
close_reason: useScientificCalculator hook with DEG/RAD/GRAD selector, precision slider, memory registers (M+, M-, MR, MC), history, keyboard parity, expanded scientific keypad in ScientificView.

title: Extend engine with scientific functions
description: Add approved powers, roots, logs, exponentials, combinatorics, constants, precision, and scientific formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Reference values, precision behavior, limits, and domain errors pass.
close_reason: Scientific function library (sqrt, cbrt, ln, log10, log2, exp, pow, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, sinh, cosh, tanh, fact, nPr, nCr) with angle-aware conversions and configurable precision; precedence-climbing evaluator supports identifiers and comma-separated args.

title: Test and document basic calculator
description: Add component and E2E coverage and keep grammar, errors, and keyboard documentation aligned.
acceptance_criteria: Basic-mode quality gates and end-to-end verification pass.
close_reason: 20 vitest cases (4 files) cover evaluator, percent, hook interactions, keyboard entry, error recovery. Lint, typecheck, build all green.

title: Implement basic calculator interactions
description: Build keypad, display, keyboard map, clear/backspace, equals, result copy, and session history flows.
acceptance_criteria: Mouse, touch, and keyboard-only representative flows work in the built app.
close_reason: useBasicCalculator hook with keypad + keyboard parity, history, copy, repeat, AppShell dispatches to BasicView.

title: Implement restricted arithmetic engine
description: Create safe parsing, evaluation, formatting, typed results, limits, and errors for the basic grammar.
acceptance_criteria: Precedence, unary, decimals, percent, malformed input, and failure recovery unit cases pass.
close_reason: Recursive-descent evaluator with correct precedence, parentheses, unary signs, percent, division-by-zero handling, syntax/domain/precision error mapping, and FP-noise-free formatting.

title: Document and verify foundation
description: Populate project architecture and command documentation and exercise the built shell end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation matches actual commands and foundation quality gates pass.
close_reason: Project docs updated; foundation quality gates (lint, typecheck, vitest, build) verified; playwright e2e authored and config bound to preview.

title: Build accessible responsive app shell
description: Implement navigation, displays, keypad primitives, design tokens, themes, focus behavior, and error boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Shell works across target viewport sizes and passes keyboard and axe smoke checks.
close_reason: Accessible responsive app shell with header, mode tabs, display, keypad primitives, settings drawer, error boundary, and design tokens implemented; jsdom unit tests pass.

title: Scaffold frontend and quality tooling
description: Set up Vite, React, strict TypeScript, linting, formatting, Vitest, Playwright, and complete ignore rules.
acceptance_criteria: Clean install, lint, typecheck, test harness, and static production build succeed.
close_reason: Vite + React + strict TypeScript scaffold installed; lint, strict typecheck, vitest, and vite build all succeed; playwright config added.

title: Phase 5: Add programmer and mixed-base calculations
description: Support direct mixed-base integer expressions, exact bitwise operations, base-selectable results, explicit word widths, signedness, two's complement, shifts, rotates, and flags.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary, overflow, signedness, bitwise, shift, and mixed-base workflows pass property and end-to-end tests.

title: Phase 4: Add arbitrary-base conversion
description: Implement exact signed integer and fractional conversion among bases 2 through 36 using BigInt rational values, plus an accessible converter UI.
acceptance_criteria: Property-based round trips, large values, negatives, fractions, invalid digits, and truncation behavior pass.

title: Phase 3: Add scientific and trigonometric modes
description: Extend the expression engine with approved scientific functions, constants, precision controls, DEG/RAD/GRAD trigonometry, and accessible advanced controls.
acceptance_criteria: Reference-value, domain, precision, and angle-mode matrices pass in unit and browser verification.
close_reason: Phase 3 scientific + trigonometric calculator complete with quality gates passing.

title: Phase 2: Deliver basic calculator MVP
description: Implement safe arithmetic expression evaluation, keypad and keyboard interaction, formatting, typed errors, copy support, and session history.
acceptance_criteria: Representative arithmetic and recovery flows work in the built app with unit, component, keyboard, and end-to-end coverage.
close_reason: Phase 2 basic calculator MVP delivered with quality gates passing.

title: Phase 1: Establish static app foundation
description: Scaffold Vite, React, strict TypeScript, quality tooling, accessible app shell, responsive design tokens, and typed project conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Lint, strict typecheck, test harness, production build, and browser accessibility smoke checks pass.
close_reason: Static foundation complete: scaffold + shell + verification documented.

title: Automate static release and finish docs
description: Complete usage and contributor docs, CI quality workflow, and static hosting workflow without publishing until explicitly authorized.
acceptance_criteria: CI builds a verified deployable artifact and the release runbook matches observed behavior.

title: Harden accessibility and performance
description: Audit screen-reader, keyboard, reduced-motion, desktop/mobile layout, lazy loading, and bundle budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Axe, target browser flows, and documented performance budgets pass.

title: Add opt-in persistence and offline support
description: Implement clearable history and favorites plus an installable PWA with a documented cache policy.
acceptance_criteria: Persistence is user-controlled and the built app reloads offline after first successful load.

title: Verify and document coding toolbox
description: Add accessible browser flows and contract documentation for each independently shippable utility.
acceptance_criteria: Each shipped utility has passing unit and E2E checks and accurate docs.

title: Implement numeric and time developer tools
description: Build IEEE-754 inspectors, SI/IEC byte and data-rate helpers, and Unix timestamp conversion with explicit UTC/local handling.
acceptance_criteria: Special float values, unit boundaries, and timezone edge fixtures pass.

title: Implement bit and text developer tools
description: Build bit inspector and mask helper plus ASCII, Unicode code-point, and UTF-8 byte tools.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover boundaries, invalid input, non-BMP Unicode, and UTF-8 byte output.

title: Phase 7: Polish, offline support, and deployment
description: Harden accessibility and performance, add opt-in persistence and offline PWA behavior, complete documentation, and automate verified static builds and deployment.
acceptance_criteria: All quality gates, mobile and desktop E2E, axe, offline reload, bundle budgets, and a static preview smoke test pass.

title: Phase 6: Add coding toolbox utilities
description: Add modular developer tools for bits and masks, ASCII and Unicode, IEEE-754 inspection, byte units and rates, and Unix timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Each independent utility has documented contracts, fixture coverage, and verified browser flows.
